title: Undisclosed SEC Investigations
authors: Terrence Blackburne; John D. Kepler; Phillip J. Quinn; Daniel J. Taylor
near_miss_reason: Table 2 (operating and market performance and SEC investigations) regresses roa, madjreturnsm and monthlyidvol on sec_investigation, a firm-fiscal-year indicator for being under an SEC investigation (opens at firm-specific dates, 2000-2017; switches off at close), with firm and fiscal-year FE in the third column per outcome, but every column adds the time-varying controls lnta, bm, lev, loss (columns 1-2 use industry x year-type FE ffic48 + fyear without firm FE; column 2 also adds the lagged outcome). The firm-FE column's only violation is the controls. The investigation panel is a descriptive association, and outcome data (Compustat/CRSP) are not shipped.
main_or_robustness: secondary (Table 2 descriptive performance regressions; headline analyses are long-window returns and insider selling around investigation openings)
eligible_reason: No column satisfies every rule. Table 2: time-varying controls in every column (firm+year FE columns at BKQT_Analysis.do line 52). Table 3: buy-and-hold abnormal returns after investigation openings (event-time means, no panel FE). Table 5 and IA tables: firm-day insider-selling regressions with window_0top10 x fraud_aaer (subgroup-by-treatment interaction) plus controls, firm-quarter and date FE. Data not shipped except the SEC investigation list.
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe) on SAS-built samples. Firm-year panel finalsample_v1 (CRSP/Compustat universe with sec_investigation indicator); event-return file; firm-day insider-trading sample.

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls (lnta, bm, lev, loss) in every column; otherwise firm + fiscal-year FE with binary on/off investigation indicator
specs.treatment_var: sec_investigation (firm under investigation during fiscal year)
specs.reported_location: Table 2, column 3 of each outcome block

specs.exclusion_reason: no firm FE (fyear + ffic48 industry FE); controls; column 2 adds lagged outcome
specs.reported_location: Table 2, columns 1-2 of each outcome block

specs.exclusion_reason: event window x fraud_aaer subgroup interaction; time-varying controls

data_files_note: readme.txt: only the SEC investigation list (FOIA) is shipped; CRSP, Compustat, Thomson insiders, Audit Analytics (WRDS) and the AAER data must be obtained separately; no analysis .dta files.
data_provenance_note: Treatment list shipped; outcome and control data (WRDS) not shipped.
software_notes: SAS for sample construction, Stata (reghdfe, qreg2) for analysis
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF; OpenAlex abstract empty). Recorded as a 5c controls-only near-miss on Table 2's firm+year FE columns, but excluded from 5c because data are not shipped.
